records.observation: Standalone static two-pass diagnostic. main requires one filename else exit0, times createDefs then createPrimitives, prints signed-int claimed bytes from second pass only (reset on each pass), not physical file size. createDefs opens low-level InputLog, resets maps/category/color, registers message arrow width3 with correct Header/RecMsg reflection. Scans state definitions only: each creates a fresh state/category at sequential index, without undefined-state prepopulation or duplicate reconciliation; handlers would overwrite matching event keys while earlier categories remain. However reflection explicitly requests Header/RecBare whereas actual Topo_State methods take Header/RecCargo, so first state definition throws NoSuchMethodException and exits1. Later-path observations are conditional static analysis, not successful execution claims. First pass skips event definitions, constants, bare/cargo/msg, collective, communicator, source and time shift; closes and prints categories if it reaches EOF. Second pass reopens same path without content identity check, uses previously collected handlers and skips all definitions; no state updates or solo event support. Bare/cargo/msg invoke Header plus null/cargo/msg and print/count non-null Primitive; etype -1 ignored. Missing handler yields direct NPE caught/logged/exit1; IllegalAccess and InvocationTarget exceptions log and continue. No ID map/YCoordMap, time-order checks or SLOG2 output. Both loops ignore read0, sum unchecked int lengths and log unknown record type without body resynchronization. Both type0 and type1 leave current inner loop and request another block, unlike ContentIterator terminal type0; physical EOF/short final block behavior inherited. Both close only normal path, no finally. End statistics read arrow partial list then ONLY last static stateform, not aggregate; with no state definitions in fresh invocation it remains null and this dereference throws, preventing final main statistics. Static initializer creates reusable record objects, empty constructor only Object initialization. Diagnostic defect does not establish failure in normal converter using correct handler factories.
